chunks.text: Revenue grew 15% YoY driven by strong demand across all segments.
Net income reached $108.8M, reflecting disciplined cost management.
The company continued to invest in R&D and capital expenditures.
Accounts payable increased modestly as supplier terms were renegotiated.
Gross margin remained stable at approximately 45%, in line with prior year.
The balance sheet remains strong with a healthy equity ratio.
Operating margin was 14.4%, reflecting ongoing efficiency initiatives.
Operating cash flow was $56.9M, supporting ongoing investment activities.
A healthy 15% increase in vehicle deliveries drove revenue growth this quarter.
Accounts receivable increased to $128.6M as new enterprise contracts were signed.
